auditMethod: Primary repository README, LICENSE, requirements/pyproject, inference entry points, model cards, and primary papers were inspected. No third-party repository was cloned and no checkpoint was downloaded.
hardGates: Unresolved weight or training-data rights prevent commercial adoption.
A benchmark/framework is not treated as a deployable specialist.
CPU and memory feasibility must be demonstrated on the Lythaus host before runtime adoption.
A score remains UNVALIDATED until calibration and transformation analysis admit it as directional evidence.

shortlistPolicy.runtimeStop: Free disk was approximately 52.58 GB, below the 80 GB floor; free RAM was approximately 4.03 GB and thermal telemetry was unavailable.

candidates.repository: Lythaus-owned deterministic research path; no third-party repository
candidates.paper: Classical source-camera forensic literature; implementation is not a validated camera-origin detector
candidates.task: Measure acquisition-consistent residual/CFA/noise characteristics against a provenance-confirmed enrolled device family.
candidates.signal: Pixel residual and imaging-pipeline consistency; PRNU is device-linked only when a reference fingerprint and geometric alignment exist.
candidates.generalizationEvidence: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: a known-device attribution result would not establish camera-origin detection for unseen devices.
candidates.transformRobustness: UNRESOLVED: scaling, crop, lens correction, and screenshots can break residual synchronization; JPEG and metadata stripping need controlled tests.

runtime.expectedRam: bounded classical implementation target; not measured
runtime.inferencePreprocessing: decoded pixels, residual extraction, CFA/noise measurements, and explicit alignment state
runtime.outputSemantics: raw measurement only; no camera-origin verdict

candidates.selectionBasis: The only path with controllable code/data provenance and a plausible CPU envelope, but it needs a multi-device, non-circular benchmark before it can support EF2 directionally.

candidates.task: Self-supervised photographic-feature learning from EXIF tags, with a one-class GMM or binary detector for AI-generated images.
candidates.evidenceFamily: EF2-adjacent and EF3 real-photo prior; not direct physical-camera acquisition proof
candidates.signal: High-frequency residuals from spatially scrambled patches with EXIF-supervised camera/scene/focal/aperture features.
candidates.generalizationEvidence: MODERATE paper evidence: authors report multi-generator, in-the-wild, and perturbation results; no Lythaus replication and the one-class score is a photographic-distribution anomaly, not camera proof.
candidates.transformRobustness: Paper reports common benign perturbation robustness; JPEG/crop/screenshot behavior is unverified here.
candidates.repoActivity: 9 commits; GitHub API last push 2026-03-15; 30 stars; no release

candidates.selectionBasis: Scientifically interesting photographic prior, but its EXIF-supervision and rights gaps prevent it from being an EF2 production candidate now.

candidates.candidate: SPAI: Any-Resolution AI-Generated Image Detection by Spectral Learning
candidates.task: Unsupervised real-image spectral reconstruction similarity for synthetic-image detection at arbitrary resolution.
candidates.signal: Spectral distribution modeling and reconstruction similarity; less semantic than CLIP-only detectors.
candidates.generalizationEvidence: MODERATE paper evidence: reported across 13 recent generative approaches and common online perturbations; actual Lythaus open-world transfer is untested.
candidates.transformRobustness: Paper reports robustness to common online perturbations; JPEG75, resize50, crop10, and screenshot-style resampling remain Lythaus tests.
candidates.repoActivity: Apache-2.0 repository; GitHub API last push 2025-08-01; 87 stars; 6 open issues

candidates.selectionBasis: Best current EF3 research lead for an independent spectral signal, contingent on rights review and a rights-clean cross-generator benchmark.

candidates.transformRobustness: Repository exposes blur, JPEG, resize, and crop evaluation controls; no Lythaus measurements.
